nodes.summary: It is not the case that for every countably infinite non-abelian nilpotent group $G$ the lattice of all (not necessarily Hausdorff) group topologies on $G$ is not modular; that is, some countably infinite non-abelian nilpotent group has a modular lattice of group topologies.
nodes.title: A countable nilpotent group with modular lattice of group topologies

nodes.summary: This proposition states that for every countably infinite non-abelian nilpotent group $G$, the lattice $\mathcal{L}(G)$ of all (not necessarily Hausdorff) group topologies on $G$ is not modular.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 14.4(b) (countable nilpotent groups)

nodes.summary: There is a topology on $\mathbb{Z}$ that makes $(\mathbb{Z}, +)$ a Hausdorff topological group and in which the sequence $(2^n + 3^n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ converges to $0$. That is, Kourovka Problem 15.79 has a positive answer.
nodes.title: A Hausdorff group topology on the integers in which 2ⁿ + 3ⁿ tends to zero

nodes.summary: The statement that there is a topology on $\mathbb{Z}$ that makes $(\mathbb{Z}, +)$ a Hausdorff topological group and in which the sequence $(2^n + 3^n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ converges to $0$.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 15.79 (Protasov's question on the integers)

nodes.summary: There is a nilpotent group $G$ whose lattice of all (not necessarily Hausdorff) group topologies is not modular.
nodes.title: A nilpotent group with non-modular lattice of group topologies

nodes.summary: This proposition states that some nilpotent group $G$ has a non-modular lattice $\mathcal{L}(G)$ of all (not necessarily Hausdorff) group topologies.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 14.4(a) (nilpotent groups with non-modular topology lattice)

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
